fichas.title: Sound Insulation: Structure-Borne Sound
fichas.summary: Structure-borne sound is vibration in solid bodies caused by airborne sound or direct mechanical excitation. The page describes measures to limit its excitation and transmission, including elastic isolation for pipes, equipment, lifts, and foundations; correct placement and loading of springs; and avoiding resonance. It also notes that double elastic suspension can improve sound insulation, while unfavourable interactions can worsen it.
uses: Reduce structure-borne sound transmission and vibration
Isolate pipes, equipment, and lifts from the building structure
Support equipment on elastic or sound-insulated foundations
